notes: Phase 1 bridges via src/algorithms/connectivity/bridges.rs. Iterative DFS with low-link tracking + per-vertex incoming-edge tracking (to support multigraphs without misclassifying parallel parent edges). Karate 3.8 µs ≈ articulation 3.2 µs (same Tarjan-style DFS). Path-1000 at 73 µs scales linearly. Per-vertex Vec alloc in incident() pre-cache is the main overhead; addressable via a future neighbours-as-slice API.
